mintAuthority.summary: nOPAL has independent native issuance on Ethereum, Plume, and BSC. On each native deployment, the nOPAL BoringVault is owned by the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a (172,800-second minimum delay), while the Teller and Manager are owned by the same current 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982. These are native issuance controls on three independent liability surfaces, not bridge-admin controls; issuance remains unbounded and no independent whole-supply reconciliation or prudential supervision was found.

controls.label: Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault Teller (issuance/redemption)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770766, owner() on the nOPAL Teller 0xa5f8e5843dd597a179453bf782844e8bf808a90b returned the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982.

controls.label: Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault Manager (strategy/admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770766, owner() on the nOPAL Manager 0xea452b14fc86847182f8dd0486206eb56dda0393 returned the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982, which can authorize the Manager's vault-management issuance path.

controls.label: Nest vault owner Safe (3-of-6) — Ethereum
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770766, the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 owns the nOPAL Teller and Manager and has PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE on the nOPAL Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. getThreshold() returned 3, getOwners() returned the six listed signers, and getModulesPaginated() returned no enabled modules; the Timelock getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds.

controls.label: Nest nOPAL token owner Timelock — Ethereum
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770766, nOPAL owner() returned the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. Its getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds; the verified BoringVault owner-authenticated enter() path has no supply cap, so this owner-controlled path is direct native issuance after the Timelock delay.

controls.evidence: At Plume block 87688297, owner() on the nOPAL Teller 0xa5f8e5843dd597a179453bf782844e8bf808a90b returned the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982. The official Nest registry lists this same Teller for the nOPAL vault's Plume deployment.

controls.evidence: At Plume block 87688297, owner() on the verified ManagerWithMerkleVerification 0xea452b14fc86847182f8dd0486206eb56dda0393 returned the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982, and vault() returned the Plume nOPAL deployment 0x119dd7daff816f29d7ee47596ae5e4bdc4299165.

The Safe owns the Plume nOPAL Teller and Manager and has PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE on the Plume nOPAL Timelock, whose minimum delay is 172800 seconds.

The same Safe is the current proposer and canceller, while the verified BoringVault owner-authenticated enter() path has no supply cap.

review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-08-16 across the complete native scope: Nest's current vault registry identifies the nOPAL share token and Teller, while verified Manager contracts on Ethereum, Plume, and BSC return the nOPAL deployment from vault(); direct owner() reads confirm the same per-chain control graph. The nOPAL token owner Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a returned a 172800-second minimum delay on all three chains; the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 is the current proposer and canceller on each Timelock, with no enabled Safe modules. Fixed observations on 2026-08-16 recorded nonzero totalSupply on Ethereum (19,094,202.277440 at block 25770421), Plume (12,981,544.220067 at block 87678480), and BSC (13,997,699.499774 at block 116347230). These are three independent native liabilities; the route inventory's Plume and BSC rows are native-issuance routes, not bridge representations. Nest's issuer-operated hourly NAV, live vault composition, and flow-of-funds pages do not provide independent recurring reconciliation of total nOPAL liabilities across deployments, and Nest DAO LLC is not a prudentially supervised fund issuer. No public bridge topology, OFT, lockbox, adapter, or destination-token mint role was identified. The owner Safe controls the Teller and Manager issuance path, and the owner Timelock can call the owner-authenticated BoringVault enter() path; no economic cap was verified. The existing evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nOPAL supply to portfolio assets was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: Nest's live positions, price, NAV, vault, flow-of-funds, and terms pages remain issuer-operated, and no reserve-attestor report was found that independently reconciles total nOPAL liabilities across deployments. Reconciliation review 2026-08-15: Nest's dated Available Vaults snapshot describes nOPAL as a multi-asset vault share and its Audits register lists smart-contract audits, but no named third-party report or recurring attestation reconciling total nOPAL liabilities across its EVM and Solana deployments to the portfolio was found; the available evidence therefore remains insufficient for periodic reconciliation.
